tracks.title: Finding the library and cafeteria

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: すみません。図書館はどこですか。
turns.english: Excuse me. Where is the library?

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: 図書館は二階にあります。
turns.english: The library is on the second floor.

turns.speaker: female
turns.english: Is the cafeteria also on the second floor?

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: いいえ、食堂は一階です。入口の近くです。
turns.english: No, the cafeteria is on the first floor, near the entrance.

comprehensionPrompts: Which floor is the cafeteria on?

tracks.title: Finding the restroom and reception

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: すみません。トイレはどこですか。
turns.english: Excuse me. Where is the restroom?

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: トイレはあそこです。階段の右です。
turns.english: The restroom is over there, to the right of the stairs.

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: ありがとうございます。受付はどこですか。

comprehensionPrompts: Where is the restroom relative to the stairs?
